Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ اَمْسَيْتُ لَكَ عَبْدًا دَاخِرًا
Translation: O Allah, I have come to this evening as Your humble servant

Arabic text: لَا اَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِيْ نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا
Translation: I do not possess any power to benefit or harm myself
Nor can I avert any evil from myself
I bear witness to this against myself

Arabic text: وَاَعْتَرِفُ لَكَ بِضَعْفِ قُوَّتِيْ وَقِلَّةِ حِيْلَتِي
Translation: And I confess to You my weak strength and limited resources

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And fulfill for me what You have promised me
And all believing men and believing women
Of forgiveness on this night
And complete upon me what You have granted me
For I am Your poor and humble servant
The weak, the needy, the lowly

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْنِيْ نَاسِيًا لِذِكْرِكَ فِيْمَا اَوْلَيْتَنِي
Translation: O Allah, do not make me forgetful of Your remembrance in what You have entrusted me with
Nor heedless of Your favors in what You have given me

Arabic text: وَلَا آيِسًا مِنْ إِجَابَتِكَ وَإِنْ اَبْطَأَتْ عَنِّي
Translation: Nor despairing of Your response even if it is delayed from me
In ease or hardship
In difficulty or comfort
In well-being or affliction
In misery or blessing
Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplications
